question: Shiv Dayal Saheb, a banker from Agra, founded the Radha Soami Satsang in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1861.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Shiv Dayal Saheb founded the Radha Soami Satsang in Agra on August 15, 1861.**
 
• ** Radha Soami Satsang** is a spiritual organization that teaches the **importance of meditation and inner spiritual development to attain God-realization.**
 
• The teachings of Radha Soami Satsang are based on the principles of **Sant Mat, which emphasizes the importance of living a moral and ethical life, practicing meditation, and following the guidance of a spiritual teacher or guru.**
